# MDL905 · `forbidden-key`

<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs from internal/rules: do not edit. -->

A key or group the conventions forbid is present.

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | conventions |
| Default severity | error |
| Fix | — |

## Why

Forbidden keys keep secrets or dangerous settings out of versioned files. The rule does nothing unless the `conventions` section of the configuration sets it up.

## Example

❌ Before:

```ini
[client]
user=u
[mydumper]
password=x
```

```text
1:2-1:8 error MDL905[forbidden-key] the [client] group is forbidden by the conventions
4:1-4:9 error MDL905[forbidden-key] password is forbidden in [mydumper] by the conventions
```

## Configuration

Enabled by default. To change its severity or turn it off:

```yaml
rules:
  severity:
    MDL905: warning   # or error, info, off
```

To accept one occurrence, put `# mydumper-lint: disable-next-line=MDL905` on the line above it.
